title: PrefixMemory-Tuning: Modernizing Prefix-Tuning by Decoupling the Prefix from Attention

summary.en: PrefixMemory-Tuning moves prefix information outside attention into a trainable, query-conditioned memory. Adding this memory output to frozen attention avoids the shared-softmax competition between input and prefix contributions, improving parameter-efficient adaptation across the evaluated classification, preference-alignment, and math-reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: PrefixMemory-Tuning 将前缀信息移出 attention，改为可训练的查询条件记忆，并与冻结的注意力输出相加，避免输入与前缀在共享 softmax 中争夺权重，在分类、偏好对齐和数学推理评测中改善参数高效适配。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of PrefixMemory-Tuning: input branches into frozen backbone attention and trainable query-conditioned memory phi(q)^T M; their outputs are added outside the attention softmax.

LoRA uses rank 64; Prefix-Tuning uses 32 virtual tokens; PMT uses ELU features. These diagnostic few-shot results do not imply identical trainable-parameter counts or universal gains. Preference alignment and critique-based math fine-tuning are evaluated separately. The entry date follows the initial arXiv submission (June 16, 2025).
